title: 第17章 畅聊过去第18章 学院新伙伴
slug: 斗罗穿成宁荣荣的妹妹一路成神
content_zh:
“奥斯卡，我的宿舍在哪？”
宁荣荣回头，看向奥斯卡。
奥斯卡立刻恢复正经：“啊，阿这个……我们这的宿舍都是三人一间的，宁苒苒这间，是唯一一间单人间。
学院小，房间不够。”
宁荣荣：“为什么？我就想和我妹妹同一间！”
“呃，这个要不荣荣你等苒苒醒了问问她的意见？”
奥斯卡小心翼翼的询问。
宁荣荣：“好吧，我就等苒苒休息好了我再问。”
———分割线———
夜幕降临，月光洒落，仿佛一层轻纱，满天繁星闪烁着光芒，像无数银珠，密密麻麻镶嵌在深黑色的夜幕上。
“咳咳，好渴啊，有水吗？”
黑暗中，宁苒苒从床上坐起来，“给。”
突如其来的声音吓了宁苒苒一跳。
“三哥？”
她声音带了点疑惑。
“嗯。
是我。”
唐三转身去开灯。
“啪——”
一声开了灯，整个房间亮如白昼。

宁苒苒才看清楚唐三。
唐三显然已经把中午考试时因为受伤而沾染血迹的衣服换下来了，一身墨蓝色劲装，身姿颀长，气质温润。
宁苒苒喝了水感觉嗓子好多了，她抬头问：“三哥一直在这吗？”
唐三接过空杯，笑道：“我在门外，听见你在喊着口渴就进来了。”
宁苒苒张了张嘴，正要说话，唐三打断：“肚子饿不饿？这么晚了，我先去给你弄点吃的。”
然后匆匆离去，宁苒苒愣了好半天，硬是没跟上思路。
宁苒苒其实还想问唐三，他不会一直守在门外吧？！
唐三很快去而复返，手里端着碗香喷喷的肉粥：“今天太晚了，厨房那边也没什么好吃的，大家都以为你可能要明天才醒，还好我提前给你煮了粥热着。”
唐三不说还好，一说宁苒苒还真觉得自己饿得饥肠辘辘。
接过肉粥就开始一小口一小口的吹凉往嘴里送，唐三就坐在床边上看着她吃，时不时给她擦擦嘴。
宁苒苒：“对了三哥，你吃了没有？”
“吃过了。”
然而唐三没说的是，他因为不放心宁苒苒一个人，只匆匆吃了几口就又回来守着了。
“哦，那你去看过小舞了吗？她伤的怎么样了？”
唐三：“她已经没事了。”
刚刚还和他们一起吃晚饭，想来没有大碍了，只是苒苒对小舞未免太过于关注了，她们明明才第一次见面啊？
唐三心里疑惑，面上不显：“苒苒为什么这么关心小舞？你们是认识吗？”
“没有没有。”
宁苒苒连连摇头：“小舞不也是你妹妹吗？我当然关心她了。”
唐三疑惑：“谁说小舞是我妹妹的？我和小舞只是朋友，她是我去诺丁学院的时候认识的。”

然后笑着摸摸宁苒苒的头发：“我的妹妹只有你一个。”
宁苒苒呆住了：“什，什么？！
你没有认小舞当你妹妹！
content_en:
"Oscar, where is my dormitory?"
Ning Rongrong turned back and looked at Oscar.
Oscar immediately returned to his seriousness: "Ah, well... our dormitories are all for three people to a room, and Ning Ranran's room is the only single room.
The college is small and there are not enough rooms. "
Ning Rongrong: "Why? I just want to be in the same room as my sister!"
"Uh, why don't Rongrong wait until Ranran wakes up and ask her for her opinion?"
Oscar asked cautiously.
Ning Rongrong: "Okay, I'll wait until Ranran has rested before asking again."
——Separating line————
As night falls, the moonlight shines like a veil, and the stars in the sky are shining like countless silver beads, densely embedded in the deep black night.
"Ahem, I'm so thirsty. Is there any water?"
In the darkness, Ning Ranran sat up from the bed and said, "Here."
The sudden sound startled Ning Ranran.
"Third brother?"
There was a hint of confusion in her voice.
"Hmm.
It's me. "
Tang San turned around and turned on the light.
"Pah——"
Turning on the light, the whole room was as bright as day.
Only then did Ning Ranran see Tang San clearly.
Tang San had obviously changed out of the clothes that were stained with blood due to injuries during the noon exam. He was dressed in dark blue clothes, with a tall figure and a gentle temperament.
Ning Ranran drank water and felt that her throat was much better. She raised her head and asked, "Has Third Brother been here all this time?"
Tang San took the empty cup and said with a smile: "I was outside the door and came in when I heard you shouting that you were thirsty."
Ning Ranran opened her mouth and was about to speak when Tang San interrupted: "Are you hungry? It's so late. I'll get you something to eat first."
Then he left in a hurry. Ning Ranran was stunned for a long time, unable to follow his train of thought.
Ning Ranran actually wanted to ask Tang San, wouldn't he always be guarding the door? !
Tang San quickly left and returned, holding a bowl of fragrant meat porridge in his hand: "It's too late today, and there's nothing delicious in the kitchen. Everyone thought you might not wake up until tomorrow. Fortunately, I cooked the porridge for you in advance and heated it up."
It was okay if Tang San didn't say it, but Ning Ranran really felt hungry.
After taking the meat porridge, she started to cool it into her mouth in small mouthfuls. Tang San sat on the edge of the bed and watched her eat, wiping her mouth from time to time.
Ning Ranran: "By the way, third brother, have you eaten?"
"Already eaten."
However, what Tang San didn't say was that because he was worried about Ning Ranran being alone, he only ate a few bites in a hurry and then came back to guard her.
"Oh, have you gone to see Xiao Wu? How is her injury?"
Tang San: "She's fine."
I had dinner with them just now, so it was okay, but Ran Ran paid too much attention to Xiao Wu. It was obviously the first time they met?
Tang San was confused in his heart, but didn't show it on his face: "Why does Ran Ran care so much about Xiao Wu? Do you know each other?"
"No, no."
Ning Ranran shook her head: "Isn't Xiaowu your sister too? Of course I care about her."
Tang San was confused: "Who said Xiao Wu is my sister? Xiao Wu and I are just friends. I met her when I went to Notting College."
Then he smiled and touched Ning Ranran's hair: "You are the only sister I have."
Ning Ranran was stunned: "Wha, what?!
You didn't recognize Xiao Wu as your sister!
